title: Karbobala may kaisa
body:
karbobala may kaisa ye manzar zainab ne dekha
sar bhai ka zer e khanjar zainab ne dekha
<<DIVIDER>>
nanhe mujahid ka laasha jab ran se laaye hussain
teer e sitam ka zakhm galay par zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
khoon may nahaye aun o mohamed qatl huwe abbas
lut'ta hua apna hi bhara ghar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
apne jigar par barchi khaayi gaysuon waale ne
khoon may dooba laasha e akbar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
ibne hassan ke laashe par daudaye gaye ghode
tukde hua jab qasim e muztar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
jis ko rasool allah hamesha chooma karte thay
chalte huwe us halq pe khanjar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
boondhe cheene shimr e layeen ne kaan huwe zakhmi
lut'ta hua masooma ke gowhar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
<<DIVIDER>>
daaman us bachi ne najaf jab qaid may phailaya
kaise aaya godh may ek sar zainab ne dekha
karbobala may kaisa...
author: Ali Naqvi Najaf
